name: Can I fix this myself, or do I need a drywall repair pro?

mainEntity.name: Can I fix this myself, or do I need a drywall repair pro?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most people can repair very small damage themselves, but not every wall issue is a good DIY project. Simple holes from nails, screws, picture hooks, or anchors are usually eligible for a quick patch, while repeated cracking, loose drywall, or water-stained areas should be evaluated before repair.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tiny cosmetic damage is often DIY-friendly. If the wall is cracked, soft, stained, textured, or the hole is more than a small nail-size opening, professional repair is usually the better call.
